createOrReplace.title: International Baccalaureate students | UBC
createOrReplace.excerpt: General admission requirements: IB Diploma Programme - Completed IB Diploma, including at least three Higher Level courses. IB Math Applications and Interpretations SL, or IB Math Studies, do not satisfy the math requirement for admission to UBC's science-based programs, the Faculty of Management, the UBC Sauder School of Business, or the Vancouver School of Economics. When determining who receives an offer of admission, we look at more than just grades.
